digest.component_or_area: ADR (Architecture Decision Record) infrastructure and governance
propositions: ADR corpus contains 91 files with only 69 distinct numbers, creating 17 duplicate-number collisions across 22 files that must be renumbered to establish a unique bijection

Pre-merge CI collision detection is untenable; conflict-proof prevention requires per-number marker files docs/adr/.numbers/NNNN whose content is the filename, producing add/add conflicts when duplicate numbers are submitted
All 22 duplicate-numbered ADRs are renumbered to 0070-0091 by landing-date order; earliest-landed ADRs keep their numbers and receive ambiguity-window notes

Cross-references to moved ADRs across docs/ and src/ must be rewritten to their new 0070-0091 numbers and reconciled via slug-exact, topic, or ancestry matching; all rewrites and unresolvable references are recorded in docs/adr/RENUMBERING.md

CI gate scripts/check_adr_numbers.py enforces bijection between 91 ADRs and marker files, forbids duplicate marker content, and asserts referential integrity by failing on dangling adr/NNNN-slug markdown links
Generated docs/adr/README.md index groups ADRs by workstream with full slugs, and docs/adr/.numbers/ marker layer prevents future collisions via git's native conflict mechanism
